Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: In Step 11, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the data from the ATP Tour website screenshot. The screenshot clearly displayed "Career High Rank (1988.09.12): 51". However, the Planner's analysis claimed the career high was "No. 4 (1988)". The number "4" likely came from a misreading of the "Doubles" section visible on the page (which showed a career high doubles ranking of 4), or a hallucination/error in reading the text. This error led to the false conclusion that Jorge Lozano had a better ranking than Roberta Vinci (No. 4 vs No. 7), when in reality, Vinci's No. 7 was better than Lozano's No. 51. The WebSurfer correctly presented the data in the previous turn, but the Planner failed to extract and interpret it accurately.
